Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. India Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Alyssa Healy and Rachael Haynes who come out to open for Australia Women. Jhulan Goswami to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...
Australia should chase this down! They have a strong batting lineup and the wicket is a good one. The Indians will have to bowl really well if they are to defend this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

The Australian bowling did not start off that well, it was wayward and there were far too many extras bowled. However, once they found their lines and lengths, they did really well. Darcie Brown was brilliant and she was the pick with a four-fer. The spinners did well to apply the brakes. Hannah Darlington was also very impressive on her debut. A special mention to Rachael Haynes who was absolutely majestic in the field. However, the overall fielding effort was not the best from the Aussies but they will still be pleased with the first half.

It was a real struggle for the Indian batters except for the initial phase of the game where runs were easy to come. Once the two openers fell, there was an halt to the run-flow, yes, there was a partnership building between Raj and Bhatia but it was at a slow rate which was only building the pressure. When the time came to accelerate, the visitors once again lost wickets in quick succession. Raj and Bhatia both got out after getting off to starts and minimal contribution from the middle order saw India struggling entering the last 5. However, Ghosh along with Jhulan Goswami played really well to get India to a total which is not par but they can think of defending it.

32 runs in the last 3 overs has given the Indian bowlers something to bowl at! However, it will be the Aussies who will be a lot more pleased with their perfomance on this track which seems good enough to bat on.
Full and on middle. Ghosh makes room and works it through cover for another single. India Women end their innings at 225/8.
Floated, around off. Singh guides it towards third man for a single.
On off, pushed to cover.
Stumping appeal and it is referred! Goswami is walking back already.

OUT! STUMPED! Sophie Molineux gets her second wicket. Jhulan Goswami looks to go after this one, but it proves to be a costly one. Flighted, outside off. Jhulan Goswami skips down the track and looks to hit it downtown but misses it completely. The ball goes through to the keeper. Alyssa Healy does well to collect the ball and was quick to whip the bails off. Jhulan Goswami has to depart after a cameo.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Sophie Molineux

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off. Ghosh comes across and looks to sweep it away. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards fine leg. The ball lands safely. They get one.
A single now, as this is eased to long on.

SIX! All the way! This is the over India Women needed. A full-length ball, on off. Richa Ghosh hangs back and powers it over the long on fence for a biggie. 17 runs coming off the over. An eventful over for India Women.
A full-length ball, around off. Richa Ghosh stays back and lifts it over mid off. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
A length ball, outside off. Jhulan Goswami punches it towards long off for a run.
Full and on the pads. Jhulan Goswami flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The batters take two comfortably.
On a length, around off. Jhulan Goswami works it towards cover.
SIX! BANG! Jhulan Goswami gets it all the way. A full-length ball, on off. Jhulan Goswami whips it across the line. The ball goes over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Floated full and outside off. Goswami works it through cover for another single.
Full and on off. Ghosh works it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Two boundaries in a row. Flatter and outside off. Ghosh cuts it through point. The ball races away to the boundary. 200 up for India Women now.
FOUR! Nicely played by Richa Ghosh. Short and around off. Ghosh hangs back and guides it past short third man. The fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race. Boundary.
Full and on off. Goswami pushes it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Goswami punches it to cover.
On a length, around the hips. Ghosh hangs back and works it to square leg but straight to the fielder.
A length ball, on off. Jhulan Goswami pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
A full-length ball, around off. Jhulan Goswami works it to cover off the outer half.

FOUR! Deft touch by Jhulan Goswami. A length ball, outside off. Jhulan Goswami hangs back, opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man. The ball goes past the fielder and races away into the boundary. Smart play by Jhulan Goswami.
Full and on off. Jhulan Goswami pushes it to cover.
On a length, around off. Goswami taps it to point.
On the pads. Goswami tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.

Floated full and on middle. Ghosh stays inside the crease and lifts it to the right of mid on. Darcie Brown covers a lot of ground to her right, she puts in a dive to that side to save a certain boundary. The batters take a single. That is poor running! That should have easily been two.
Play and a miss! Short and outside off. Ghosh looks to cut it away but misses.
Full and outside off. Jhulan Goswami slashes it through cover for a single.
Flatter and on off. Goswami works it to cover.
Flighted, around leg. Goswami looks to dig it out but misses.
A good finish to the over by Hannah Darlington. She serves it full and on middle. Ghosh gets an inside edge and onto the pads. The ball rolls out to the off side.
A single now! Full length and outside off. Jhulan Goswami drives it to cover off the front foot. The batters cross for a single.
Two dots in a row! A length ball, on off. Goswami pushes it to cover.
A dot now! A length ball, outside off. Jhulan Goswami hangs back and looks to cut it away but misses. The ball beats the outside edge.
Full and outside off. Ghosh pushes it to point and rotates the strike.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary. Full and around off. Ghosh stays back and lofts it over cover. The ball goes to the fence at cover. Boundary.
Slower through the air and on off. Goswami defends it out watchfully. India need some boundaries at the moment. The run flow has dried up.
Flatter and outside off. Goswami goes back and looks to work it to the off side but misses.
Tossed up, around off. Ghosh skips down the track and lifts it towards long off. The ball meets the fielder on a bounce. They take one.
Floated full and around off. Ghosh defends it onto the pitch.
Flighted full and on off. Ghosh digs it out to cover.
Short and outside off. Ghosh stays back and cuts it to point.
Full and on off. Goswami pushes it to cover. Brilliant over by Hannah Darlington, just three runs and a wicket off it.
Who will come out now? Jhulan Goswami it is.

OUT! TIMBER! Hannah Darlington announces herself in the ODI format. She aims for the sticks and gets another wicket. Sneh Rana has to go back for 2. A length ball, around middle and leg. Rana stays inside the crease and looks to push it out but misses. The ball goes through the gap between bat and pad, to take the leg stump on its way through. India slip further. Darlington got the ball to swing back in there. Really nicely bowled. She is having a lovely debut.
Another single! Full and wide outside off. Ghosh reaches out and slashes it through covers for a run.
Full and on middle. Rana flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around middle. Rana plays it back to the bowler.
A full-length ball, on off. Ghosh drives it towards mid off. The fielder there misfields which allows the batters to collect an easy single.
On the pads. Ghosh clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
On off, kept out by Ghosh.

DROPPED! Flighted, full toss, around middle and leg. Rana hangs back and looks to play it across the line. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards cover. The fielder comes running in, puts in a forward dive but the ball lands just short. The batters pick up a single.
Looped up, on the pads. Rana hangs back and tucks it to the leg side.
Flighted and on off. Rana defends it out.
Floated, full and around off. Ghosh works it towards long off for a single.
Another dot to end! That is a wicket maiden from Hannah Darlington! Outstanding. On off, this is played back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
A yorker outside off. Rana looks to jam it out but doesnot connect.
Shortish and outside off, Rana looks to cut but is beaten.
Outside off, left alone.
Who will come out now? Sneh Rana it is.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a soft dismissal! On middle, Pooja looks to flick, closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge and the fielder at mid-wicket takes an easy catch. It is all falling apart now for the Indians.
Commentary.Howout: c Sophie Molineux b Hannah Darlington

Commentary.Commentary: It is time for Powerplay 3! Now, maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle.
Yes, she does! Shorter and outside off, Pooja slaps it to the left of the bowler. She dives and gets a hand to it, can't stop the run.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler. Just the one run from the over. Can she end it well?
Gives it a lot of flight and bowls it outside off. Pooja leaves it alone thinking it is a wide. Not given.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Outside off, this is guided to the fielder at point.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A length ball, on off. Ghosh pushes it through cover for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Ghosh looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hit the pads and goes back to the bowler.
Short and outside off. Ghosh stays back and looks to cut it away but misses.
TWO LEG BYES! A full-length ball, on the pads. Ghosh looks to flick it away but misses. The ball clips the pads and goes towards fine leg. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
On the pads. Vastrakar hangs back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar works it towards third man.
Another dot to end! End of a successful over from Sophie Molineux. On off, flatter, it is guided to point.
On off, blocked.
Richa Ghosh walks out at number 7.

OUT! STUMPED! There is the wicket Australia were looking for! The well-set Raj has to walk back! That is beautifully bowled. Beats Raj in the flight. Sophie Molineux floats it up on off, Raj comes down the track, the ball dips at the very end. Raj looks to whip it across the line probably thinking she can take it on the full. It sneaks under the bat, bounces extra after that. Alyssa Healy does well to collect it and then whips the bails off. Now 230 looks a long way away for India.
Commentary.Howout: st Alyssa Healy b Sophie Molineux

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and on the pads, Raj flicks but to square leg.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped down to long off for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.

Another dot! Raj will be a little disappointed she could not put that away! Shorter and outside off, she tries to guide it past backward point but finds the fielder. A little to the left or the right and it would have been a boundary.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Two more! Fuller and outside off, Raj drives, it goes through the hands of the fielder at cover. Two taken.
Uppish but safe! On off, this is lofted over cover for two.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Shorter and on middle, Pooja pulls it hard towards mid-wicket. The fielder makes a half-stop. Can't stop the run.
Floats it up on middle, blocked.
Another single! On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped through covers for one more.
On off, Pooja pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Another run to end! Angled into the pads, Pooja clips it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Misfield and a run! On middle, Raj flicks it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder lets it through. One more taken.
Angled into the pads, Pooja works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
BEATEN! Well bowled! Length and outside off, Raj looks to push at it but is beaten. She does so inside the line.
Shorter and on off, Raj pushes it to mid off.
Hannah Darlington comes back into the attack. Her figures read 2-0-8-0 so far. She replaces Darcie Brown.
Shorter and on off, Pooja pushes it to covers.
That has gripped! On middle, this one holds in the surface and also turns away. Pooja pushes it back to the bowler.
Raj now takes one as this is pushed down to long off.
Another single as this is eased down to long on.
On middle, Pooja works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
FOUR! Crunched! That is a serious pull shot! It made a cracking sound of the bat! Short and on middle, this is nailed over mid-wicket. Boundary.

Overthrow and two! Shorter, Pooja is not backing down from playing the pull shot. She hits it over mid on. They take one. The throw is not a good one towards the bowler who fails to collect it cleanly, it hits her leg and rolls on the leg side. Another run taken.

Fifty for Raj! She has held fort at one end! Really good innings from her. Not at the pace she would have liked but it was important for her to stay in there. Can she bat till the end now? Angled into her pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another short one. Raj leaves it alone.
Top edge but safe! Short again, Pooja looks to pull but once again this hurries onto her. It goes off the splice but over covers for one.
Almost another one! A short one on middle, Pooja Vastrakar looks to pull, this goes off the splice back towards the bowler who dives forward but it lands short.
FOUR! Nicely played by Raj. Short and outside off. Raj hangs back and guides it towards third man. The ball races away to the boundary. Raj moves to 49 now.
On off, kept out.
Full and on off. Pooja Vastrakar works it to towards mid on.
WIDE! Loopy ball, sliding down leg. Pooja Vastrakar looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
On the pads. Pooja Vastrakar tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floated around middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it towards mid on.
Full and on off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it to cover.
A dot to end! On off, blocked.
BEATEN! Some swing! Length and outside off, shapes away. Raj looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Nudged nice and fine! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side. It races away to the fence.
WIDE! A short one but it is way too short. Ducked under. Wided.
Pooja Vastrakar comes out at number 6.

OUT! TAKEN! Darcie Brown gets her woman! The dropped catch does not cost a lot and Brown has her 4th. Really good short ball, gets big on the batter who tries to pull. This goes off the top edge towards square leg where it is taken by the fielder, Wareham. The dangerous Deepti Sharma walks back and India now in big trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Georgia Wareham b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
A good short one, Raj evades it.
Floated and on off. Raj works it to long off for another single.
Full and on off. Sharma comes down the track and punches it through cover for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Sharma pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Nicely played. Sharma making use of the extra life. Wareham serves it full and on off. Sharma skips down the track and whips it past mid on. The ball races away to the boundary.
Full and on off, kept out by Sharma.
Flighted, full and outside off. Sharma gets low and looks to sweep it away but misses.

DRINKS! Australia on top at the moment! They have applied the brakes on the scoring and have also broken the stand that was going well. More of the same is what they will be hoping for. India on the other hand, need to up the ante a little. They need someone to provide the much-needed impetus. Deepti Sharma can surely do that but they will have to ensure they do not lose any more wickets for sometime now.

DROPPED! On a length, on the fourth stump line. Deepti Sharma hangs back and looks to guide it towards thrid man. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of first slip. Meg Lanning there dives to her left but could not grab onto it. The batters cross. Deepti Sharma gets a life. Could prove costly, if she gets going, she can be really dagerous.
Four dots! A length ball, outside off, moving away from the left-hander. Sharma does not have any stroke to offer.
Three dots in a row! A length ball, around off. Sharma stays insde the crease and defends it out.
A short ball, outside off. Sharma leaves it alone for the keeper.
Touch fuller and around off. Sharma hangs back and guides it to point.
A length ball, on the pads. Raj stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Raj skips down the track and works it to long off for a single.
A dot now! Flighted and on off. Raj pushes it to the left of the bowler. Georgia Wareham goes to that side and makes the stop.
Full and on off. Sharma pushes it through cover for a run.
Fuller and on off. Sharma gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. The batters take two, as the fielder in the deep fumbles.
Flighted full and on off. Sharma plays it back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Raj works it to long off for a single.
Yes, she does. A length ball, around middle. Sharma stays back and defends it out solidly. A wicket maiden for Darcie Brown.
A length ball, outside off. Sharma leaves it alone. Can Brown get a wicket maiden?
Brown serves it on a length, outside off. The ball nips away. Sharma has no stroke to offer yet again.
A length ball, outside off. Sharma leaves it alone for the keeper.
On a length, outside off. Moving away a bit. Sharma leaves it alone.
Deepti Sharma walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Yes, she can find the breakthrough. Darcie Brown gets her third wicket of the innings. Yastika Bhatia has to depart after a good knock of 35 runs. A length ball, outside off, moving away a bit. Bhatia stays inside the crease and looks to punch it through covers, but she ends up hitting it uppishly. Rachael Haynes is there to complete the catch. A much-needed breakthrough for Australia Women and Darcie Brown has been their go-to source. Bhatia wil be really disappointed. She was playing so well. Could have left that one but ended up poking at it away from the body. Once more the combination of Rachael Haynes and Darcie Brown combine. The former has fielded brilliantly and the latter has bowled really well.
Commentary.Howout: c Rachael Haynes b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Darcie Brown is back! She was the one who got the two wickets earlier on, can she get another one for her side?
Short and on off. Bhatia pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. 7 runs coming off the over.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Yastika Bhatia looks in some good touch. Full and outside off. Bhatia works it towards third man. The ball races away to the boundary.
Flighted and outside off. Raj comes down the track and lifts it uppishy through covers. They take another single.
Floated and on off. Bhatia skips down the track and pushes it to cover for a single.
Looped up, full and outside off. Bhatia guides it towards short third man.
A full-length ball, around middle and leg. Bhatia works it through mid-wicket off the inner half. The batters take a single. 5 runs off the over.
On off, worked through covers for another single.
A length ball, just outside off. Bhatia stays back and punches it through cover for a single.
Nicely driven but there is fielder down the ground. Full length and on off. Raj drives it down the ground towards long off. They take one.
WIDE! A length ball, outside the tramline. Raj leaves it alone. Wide called.
Around middle, touch fuller. Raj hangs back and works it to mid-wicket.
Full and on off. Raj nudges it to mid-wicket.
Full and around leg. Bhatia moves across and sweeps it to short fine leg.
Looped up, full and around off. Raj pushes it to mid off. They take one.
Tossed up, outside off. Raj works it to point.
Flighted full and on off. Raj works it to cover.
Full and on off. Raj stays back and defends it solidly.
Floated and on off. Raj pushes it to cover.
Full and outside off. Raj stays back and pushes it through covers. They take one. Just three runs off the over then.
Full length and outside off. Bhatia drives it through cover for another single.
A single now! On a length, around off. Raj pushes it through cover for a single.
A very good start for the debutant, Hannah Darlington. Three dots on the trot. A length ball, on off. Raj plays it towards mid off.
Two dots in a row. Full, around middle and leg. Raj stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
A full-length ball, around off. Raj stays back and pushes it to mid off.
Floated, around off. Bhatia goes back and defends it out.
Hannah Darlington is on now!
Loopy ball, outside off. Bhatia punches it to cover.
Full and on off. Bhatia defends it out.
Tossed up, around off. Raj pushes it towards mid off and rotates the strike.
Flatter and on the pads. Bhatia works it to long on for a single.
Full toss and on off. Raj skips down the track and pushes it through cover for a single.
A single! On middle, this one stays a touch low. Raj works it through square leg for one.
Outside off, Raj pushes it to covers.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed down to long off for one.
Uses her feet and lofts it over mid on, not off the middle but gets enough to clear her, two taken.
Flatter and on middle, Raj works it to mid-wicket.
A single to end and that is five from the first over of Georgia Wareham! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to point.
Gives it air again and lands it on middle, Raj pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely use of the feet. Steps out, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over mid off for a welcome boundary.
Another one tossed up on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Floats it up on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Georgia Wareham comes into the attack.
A single to end then! On off, this is pushed down to long off which was just moved back. One taken. Another tidy over from Sophie.
Nicely bowled! Slows it up and lands it on off, blocked.
Fires this one on middle, Raj defends it out nicely.
Flatter and on off, defended nicely.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one more.
Good stop! Shorter and on middle, Bhatia pulls it hard but towards square leg who dives and stops it nicely.
Two more to end! On the pads, Raj works it fine, it clips the outer part of the keeper's glove and goes down towards fine leg for two.
The sweep comes out, it is played through mid-wicket for one.
A little bit of turn! On middle, Bhatia hangs back and defends.
On middle, Bhatia plays it back to the bowler.
Two more! Bhatia comes down the track again and lofts it nicely over the mid off fielder for two.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, Bhatia defends it nicely. A tidy start from Sophie Molineux.
Lovely shot! That is a little too full and on off, Raj lofts it over covers. They take two. There is a slight confusion whether to go for the third or no, in the end they do and complete it.
Well fielded! Another one tossed up on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Another one on off, this is once again pushed to covers.
Flatter and on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Tossed up nicely and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Sophie Molineux comes into the attack now.
Just short! On middle, Bhatia comes down the track and hits it hard, uppishly but just short of the bowler.
Once again uses her feet, gets to the pitch of it and hits it past mid on for two.
Bhatia now comes down the track, gets way too close to the pitch of the ball, jams it out to mid on.
In the air... safe! Raj comes down the track, does not quite get to the pitch of it but still goes ahead with the shot. Lofts it over mid on for one.
Tossed up on off, Raj pushes it to covers.
Raj comes down the track and hits it firmly but back to the bowler.
Dot to end! On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped down the ground towards long off for two.
WIDE! Down the leg side this time, Bhatia looks to flick but misses.
Mithali Raj gets hit on her helmet. The physio comes out to the field to go through the mandatory concussion check. The physio says, Raj is fine to continue.

That is right off the helmet! What a brute of a delivery! It is short and well-directed. Raj looks to sway out of the way but fails to do so and the ball hits her on the helmet. Goes down to third man and the batters take one. Leg bye signaled. Raj seems fine as he also shows the thumps up. Good signs.
Shot! Length and on off, this is timed beautifully through covers for one.
BEATEN! Good delivery. Makes nice use of the angle. Length and around off, angles away. Bhatia looks to drive but is beaten.
Good length and on off, Bhatia drives it on the up to covers.

DRINKS! The game is quite in the balance at the moment! India initially got off to a flier but two wickets have seen the Aussies pull things back. Despite that, India are going at a decent click but these two need to keep going. Australia on the other hand, will want to break this stand which is building nicely. An important passage of play awaits.
Flighted, around middle and leg. Raj flicks it to square leg.
Overpitched and on off. Raj drives it to cover.
Flatter and on the pads. Bhatia tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, around off. Bhatia prods and defends it out.
Looped up, around middle. The ball turns away a bit. Raj stays back and flicks it to square leg for another single.
Floated and on the pads. Bhatia nudges it to deep square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! The dive does save her! Good running in the end! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers. They take one and right at the end decide to go for the second. The fielder throws it to the bowler who whips the bails off. An appeal and it is referred, the replays show that dive saves Bhatia.
A run out appeal and it is taken upstairs! Has the dive saved Bhatia?
A full-length ball, on the pads. Raj stays inside the crease and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder comes running in to her left from deep square leg. The batters pick a couple.
Full and on off. Raj pushes it to mid off.
A length ball, around off. Bhatia pushes it to the right of mid off and rotates the strike.
A length ball, around middle and off. Bhatia stays back and defends it out.
EDGY! A full-length ball, around off. Bhatia looks to push it through the off side. The ball takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg. The batters pick two runs.
Ellyse Perry comes back into the attack.
A tidy start then by Gardner! Lands it on off, gets it to turn back in. Defended.
Attacks the stumps again, Raj pushes it to covers.
Another one nicely tossed up on off, defended nicely.
Another one floated up on off, blocked nicely.

Almost! Had the keeper collected that, would have been curtains for Raj! She steps out and Gardner shortens the length, she lands it on middle and this one turns in. Raj misses the flick. It evades the keeper and goes down towards fine leg for two. It actually flicked the pad on its way and hence, leg byes given. That slight deflection saves Raj.
Floats it up nicely and on off, Raj blocks it.
Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack now. She replaces Darcie Brown.
Ouch! That might have hurt a little. A short one on middle, Bhatia looks to pull, this one stays a touch low. She misses to get hit on the body.
Outside off, Raj guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side, Raj looks to flick but misses. Wided.
Back of a length this time and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Fuller and on middle, Raj pushes it to mid on.
Up and over for two! Full and outside off, Raj lofts it over point and takes two.
On the pads, Raj looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards the keeper who stops it.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
SWING AND A MISS! Slightly short and outside off. The ball nips away a bit. Bhatia stays back and looks to cut it away but misses. The ball goes over the blade.
Full and on off. Bhatia works it towards mid off.
A short ball, around off. Bhatia sways away from the line of the delivery.
Full and around off. Bhatia tucks it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, on off. Bhatia hangs back and punches it through cover for a couple.
Back of a length and around off. Raj hangs back and guides it towards third man for a run.
Full and on the pads. Bhatia tucks it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Raj hangs back and cuts it through point for a single.
Another dot! Great start to the over by Tahlia McGrath. She serves this one on a length, outside off. Raj looks to defend it out but misses.

A loud appeal for LBW but turned down! An inswinging, full-length delivery. Raj looks to defend it out but misses. She gets hit on the pads. Tahlia McGrath puts in an appeal but the umpire says no. Going down leg.
Full and on off. Raj defends it out solidly.
BEATEN! A full-length ball, on the fourth stump line. Raj prods and looks to drive it away but misses. This was a good delivery by Tahlia McGrath.
WIDE! A length ball, way outside off. Raj lets it go to the keeper. Wide called.
WIDE! A length ball, slidng down the leg side. Raj leaves it alone. Wide called.
Short ball, around leg. Bhatia looks to pull it away but misses. The ball hits the pads and go to the right of the keeper.
FOUR! Pulled away! A short ball, on off. Bhatia stays back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Raj hangs back and guides it towards third man for a single. Raj finally gets off the mark.
A length ball, outside off. The ball nips away a bit. Raj leaves it alone.
Back of a length and just outside off. Raj sways away from the line of the delivery and leaves it alone.
A length ball, on the pads. Bhatia stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Make that 4 dots! Full, around middle and leg. Raj stays back and defends it out with a straight bat.
Three dots on the trot! On a length, outside off, moving away a bit. Raj leaves it alone for the keeper.
A full-length ball, around middle. Raj defends it to mid on off the outer half.
On the pads. Raj tucks it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, around off. Bhatia pushes it to cover for a single.
Full length and on the pads. Bhatia looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball clips the pads and goes to the right of the keeper.
A length ball, on off. Raj stays back and defends it to cover.
Back of a length and around off. Raj stays back and defends it out.
A length ball, outside off. Raj looks to chase it but does not in the end.
A length ball, around off. Raj guides it to the second slip.
BEATEN! This was a beauty by Darcie Brown. She serves it on a length, on the fourth stump line. Raj stays inside the crease and looks to poke it out but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rachael Haynes gets involved yet again, but this time she sends the batter back. Darcie Brown gets her second wicket of the game. What a start for the Aussies. A full-length ball, just outside off. Mandhana looks to chase it and push it through the off side. The ball though takes the outer half of the blade and goes to the right of point. Rachael Haynes is present there, who throws her right hand out and grabs it cleanly.
Commentary.Howout: c Rachael Haynes b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Mithali Raj walks out to bat!
WIDE! A loosener from Darcie Brown. A full-length ball, sliding down the leg side. Mandhana looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.

Brilliant from Rachael Haynes again! This is fuller and on off, it is pushed through covers. Haynes runs after it and then puts in a forward dive again and stops it just before the fence. A run saved.
Yet another dot! Full and outside off, Mandhana shoulders arms to this one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Good length this time and on middle, this is pushed to mid on again.
Fullee this time and on middle, Mandhana pushes it to mid on.
Now this one is well outside off, Mandhana lets it be.
Starts off with one down the leg side. Some inswing for Tahila but down leg. Wided.
On a length, outside off, moving away. Bhatia looks to go after it but misses.
Bhatia gets off the mark! A length ball, around off. Bhatia punches it through covers. The batters pick two runs.

A loud appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire! A length ball, around leg. The ball nips in a bit. Bhatia stays inside the crease and gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes to the left of the keeper.
Who will walk out next? It is Yastika Bhatia who comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Darcie Brown has been really good with the ball. She gets the first breakthrough for her side and it is the big wicket of Shafali Verma. A length ball, on the bodyline. Verma moves across and looks to pull it away. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of the keeper. Alyssa Healy takes a sharp catch behind the wickets.
Commentary.Howout: c Alyssa Healy b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! A length ball, outside off, moving away. Shafali Verma stays back and looks to push it to the off side but misses. The ball beats the outside edge.
A length ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana tucks it to square leg for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, around off. Mandhana stays back and punches it through cover. The batters pick two runs.
WIDE! Full-length ball, sliding down the leg side. Mandhana hangs back and looks to clip it away but misses. Wide called.

FIVE WIDES! Freebies on offer by Ellyse Perry. Full and sliding down the leg side. Mandhana looks to flick it away but misses. The keeper dives to her right but could not make the stop. The ball goes into the fence at fine leg. Wide called by the umpire.

FOUR! Flicked away! Smriti Mandhana gets into the action now. A full-length ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana stays inside the crease and flicks it through square leg. The ball races away to the boundary.
Full and on off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid off.

Great work in the field by Rachael Haynes. A length ball, just outside off. Mandhana goes back and punches it through cover. Rachael Haynes gives it a chase. She puts in a late forward dive near the ropes and keeps the ball in play successfully. The batters only get two. Rachael Haynes saves a certain boundary here.
Touch fuller and on off. Mandhana stays back and defends it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Perry is missing her line and length here. A length ball, going down the leg side. Mandhana leaves it alone. Wide called.
On a length, around middle and leg. Verma defends it to the leg side. A good start by Darcie Brown just 4 runs off the over.
Touch short and outside off. Verma hangs back and guides it towards short third man.
WIDE! A length ball, going down the leg side. Verma looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Slightly short and on off. Mandhana works it towards deep square leg for a single.
A length ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple now.
Full and on off. Smriti Mandhana keeps it out.
A length ball, on the pads. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and defends it to mid-wicket.
Who will bowl from the other end? Darcie Brown it is.
On a length, outside off. Just inside the tramline. Verma leaves it alone.
A length ball, around off. Verma pushes it to point.

FOUR! EDGY! A length ball, on the bodyline. Verma moves across and looks to pull it away. The ball takes the outside edge and flies over the keeper's head. The ball races away to the boundary at third man. The second boundary of the over for Shafali Verma.
A dot now! Full and around off. Verma hangs back and defends it out.
WIDE! Another loosener. A full-length ball, way outside off. Verma leaves this one alone as well. The keeper, dives to her right to make the stop. The umpire signals it as a wide.
WIDE! A short ball, going down leg. Verma leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire.

FOUR! Cracked! An outswinging, full-length ball, outside off. Verma stays inside the crease and drives it through covers. The outfield is fast out here. The ball races away to the boundary. The first one of the innings by Shafali Verma.
Perry starts with a length ball, just outside off, moving away a bit. Verma stays back and pushes it to cover.

The game is set to begin. But first, both the teams line-up on the pitch for the national anthems. It will be the Indian anthem first, followed by the one of the hosts. Australia Women players spread out to their respective fielding positions. Followed by Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana who come out to bat for India Women. Ellyse Perry to start with the ball.

PITCH REPORT – Elyse Villani is up for the pitch report. She says, the pitch looks like an absolute belter. Adds, it is a fresh wicket and a tinge of green which will help the new ball. Also says, it is rock hard. Mentions, if the batters survive the initial stage it could be a run-scoring feast here. Ends by saying the outfield looks like a cracker as well.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (ODI Debut), Mithali Raj (C), Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh (WK) (ODI Debut), Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Jhulan Goswami, Meghna Singh (ODI Debut), Poonam Yadav.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Rachael Haynes, Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Beth Mooney, Ashleigh Gardner, Tahlia McGrath, Sophie Molineux, Georgia Wareham, Hannah Darlington (ODI Debut), Darcie Brown.
TOSS - The coin goes up and it lands in favour of Australia Women. They have opted to FIELD first.

The visitors though have abundance of quality in their side too. However, they head into this series after losing the multi-format series against England and before that, were beaten by South Africa in their home turf. Despite their last loss though, India put up a good fight against the English in their conditions and they’ll have to play even better if they are to have any chance of winning here. They’ll be without their star performer from the 2017 semi finals against Australia, Harmanpreet Kaur. That though gives any other player to step up and show their mettle. Toss in a bit...

There’s no doubting that the Australians are overwhelming favourites heading into this game. They are on a 24-game unbeaten streak in this format and look a better side on paper when compared to the Indians.
India’s tour down under gets underway! The multi format series begins with a three-match ODI series, then a single Test and three T20Is to end. We welcome you to the coverage of the first ODI game.
